_comment: Simple, documented power model for the carbon ESTIMATE. Turns a workload (vCPU, RAM) into average watts, then kWh/month. These are deliberately rough published-style coefficients; this is an estimate, not a measurement. PUE is the datacenter overhead multiplier.
_sources: Coefficients are order-of-magnitude figures consistent with public cloud power-model literature (e.g. Cloud Carbon Footprint methodology). Replace with cited values before any non-directional use.
_utilization_comment: Used only when a caller gives a CPU utilisation. Per-vCPU power scales from an idle minimum to a full-load maximum: watts = min + utilisation x (max - min) (the Cloud Carbon Footprint / Etsy Cloud Jewels method). Without a utilisation GreenPick keeps the flat watts_per_vcpu above, which equals the AWS full-load figure, so it is a conservative (high) estimate. RAM watts do not change with load.
_utilization_sources: Cloud Carbon Footprint methodology, average min/max watts per vCPU by provider from SPECpower (https://www.cloudcarbonfootprint.org/docs/methodology/), checked 2026-11-10. Serverless: CCF's Lambda approach (1,792 MB = 1 vCPU; 50% average utilisation for hyperscale servers).
